query: select l.id as lesson_id, s.name as series_name, l.is_active as lesson_is_active, length(coalesce(l.content, '')) as content_length, c.title as chapter_title, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id and e.is_active = false and e.is_published = false) as draft_exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.exercise_questions eq join public.exercises e on e.id = eq.exercise_id where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_question_count, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_count, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id and q.is_active = false and q.is_published = false) as draft_quiz_count, (select count(*) from public.quiz_questions qq join public.quizzes q on q.id = qq.quiz_id where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_question_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id join public.series s on s.id = o.series_id where l.id in ('e89a1557-6308-4d51-8565-4fb5b1a479e6','f6759b97-8322-44ac-8c1f-33655dffd422','e56a0b7f-9337-4b03-bc2a-8a482e4090d3','d6f4155b-0744-4e1e-b60c-3d969ae18cd7') order by s.name limit 4;
